parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1 correct structure and probabilities for Box A branches. B1 completely correct Box B structure and one correct probability for a G/Y-labelled branch. B1 second correct G/Y-labelled probability. B1 remaining two correct Box B probabilities with G/Y labels. SC B1 for correct-shape diagram with only four correct algebraic probabilities for GG, GY, YG and YY. Total 4.

Draw a completely correct Box B structure and one correctly labelled G/Y probability.
Give a second correct G/Y-labelled probability.
Complete Box B with after G: $G:5/(5+x)$, $Y:x/(5+x)$; after Y: $G:4/(5+x)$, $Y:(1+x)/(5+x)$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $P(\text{same})=\frac69\frac5{x+5}+\frac39\frac{x+1}{x+5}$ (M1; accept $P(GG)+P(YY)$ using either $6/9$ or $3/9$ multiplied by their $5/(5+x)$, plus either $3/9$ or $6/9$ multiplied by their $(1+x)/(5+x)$). Equate to $8/15$ and arrange as a linear equation (M1), e.g. $15(x+11)=24(x+5)$ OE; accept the sum of their products equated to $8/15$ and rearranged to form a linear equation. Solve $x=5$ (A1). Total 3.

steps.guidance: Accept $P(GG)+P(YY)$ using the corresponding transferred-box branch probabilities.

steps.guidance: Accept an equivalent rearrangement of their two path products.
